node.statement: Write u:=row_1(M_lambda)=(1-lambda,0,lambda,0) and v:=row_2(M_lambda)=(0,1-lambda,0,lambda). By the definition of matrix multiplication and the displayed rows row_1(A_lambda)=(1,0), row_2(A_lambda)=(0,1), and row_3(A_lambda)=(1-lambda,lambda), the first three rows of A_lambda M_lambda are respectively 1*u+0*v=u=(1-lambda,0,lambda,0), 0*u+1*v=v=(0,1-lambda,0,lambda), and (1-lambda)u+lambda v=((1-lambda)^2,lambda(1-lambda),lambda(1-lambda),lambda^2).
